title: What 'Carrying' Actually Means in Addition
description: A column-by-column breakdown of what carrying the 1 actually represents when adding two numbers.
narration_lines: What does carrying the 1 actually mean?
Let's add 27 and 15, column by column.
Start on the right: 7 plus 5 is 12, so write the 2 and carry the 1. Then the left column: 2 plus 1, plus the carried 1, makes 4.
